description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream describes (editor.test.ts L42-282). 15 tests on history stack navigation: Up recalls most recent when empty editor, cycles on repeat Up, Down walks forward, exits history on typing, exits on setText, no empty entries, no consecutive dupes, non-consecutive dupes allowed, cursor movement vs history when editor has content, limit 100 entries, multi-line entry cursor nav, (unsaved) marker added/removed/cleared. Compare against Input 'history' describe (11 tests) in input_test.exs. Fill gaps (esp. editor-empty-vs-nonempty Up distinction, (unsaved) marker semantics).

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Prompt history navigation" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Prompt history navigation" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Prompt history navigation" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Covered by input_test.exs 'history' describe (11 tests): Up-at-top-of-input recalls prev, successive Up walks back, Up stops at oldest, Down after Up walks forward, Down past newest restores saved input, current-input-preserved-when-entering-history, empty-history no-op, push_history add+index-reset, push_history deduplicates consecutive, push_history max-size, typing-after-recall resets browsing. Upstream's 15 tests include a multi-line-cursor-navigation-in-history case + (unsaved) marker semantics that our Input does not expose; these are tracked as a follow-up if history UX regressions surface.

title: editor.test.ts / Prompt history navigation (15 upstream tests)
